# lib/pdf_renderer/oauth_config.rb
require 'uri'
require 'net/http'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'

module PdfRenderer
  class OAuthConfig
    ALLOWED_SCHEMES = %w[https].freeze
    CALLBACK_PATH = '/oauth/callback'

    attr_reader :client_id, :client_secret, :redirect_uri, :auth_endpoint

    def initialize(opts = {})
      @client_id = opts[:client_id] || ENV['PDF_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID']
      @client_secret = opts[:client_secret] || ENV['PDF_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET']
      @redirect_uri = opts[:redirect_uri] || ENV['PDF_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI']
      @auth_endpoint = opts[:auth_endpoint] || ENV['PDF_OAUTH_AUTH_ENDPOINT']
      @allowed_redirect_domains = load_allowed_domains
    end

    def validate_redirect(requested_uri)
      return false if requested_uri.nil? || requested_uri.empty?

      parsed = normalize_uri(requested_uri)
      return false unless parsed
      return false unless scheme_allowed?(parsed)
      return false unless domain_allowed?(parsed)
      return false unless path_safe?(parsed)

      true
    end

    def build_authorization_url(state:, redirect_override: nil)
      target_redirect = redirect_override || @redirect_uri

      unless validate_redirect(target_redirect)
        raise SecurityError, "Invalid redirect URI: #{target_redirect}"
      end

      params = {
        client_id: @client_id,
        redirect_uri: target_redirect,
        response_type: 'code',
        state: state,
        scope: 'pdf.generate pdf.read'
      }

      "#{@auth_endpoint}?#{URI.encode_www_form(params)}"
    end

    private

    def load_allowed_domains
      domains_env = ENV['PDF_OAUTH_ALLOWED_DOMAINS'] || ''
      domains_env.split(',').map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
    end

    def normalize_uri(uri_string)
      # Handle Unicode normalization for IDN domains
      cleaned = uri_string.encode('UTF-8', invalid: :replace, undef: :replace)
      # Strip null bytes and control characters
      cleaned = cleaned.gsub(/[\x00-\x1f]/, '')
      URI.parse(cleaned)
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      nil
    end

    def scheme_allowed?(parsed_uri)
      ALLOWED_SCHEMES.include?(parsed_uri.scheme&.downcase)
    end

    def domain_allowed?(parsed_uri)
      request_host = parsed_uri.host&.downcase
      return false if request_host.nil?

      @allowed_redirect_domains.any? do |allowed|
        matches_domain?(request_host, allowed.downcase)
      end
    end

    def matches_domain?(request_host, allowed_domain)
      # Allow exact match only - no subdomain matching for security
      return true if request_host == allowed_domain
      # Require explicit dot prefix to prevent suffix confusion
      request_host == "www.#{allowed_domain}"
    end

    def path_safe?(parsed_uri)
      decoded_path = URI.decode_www_form_component(parsed_uri.path || '/')
      return false if decoded_path.include?('..')
      return false if decoded_path.include?('\\')
      true
    end
  end

  class DocumentRenderer
    def initialize(oauth_config: nil)
      @oauth = oauth_config || OAuthConfig.new
      @template_cache = {}
    end

    def authenticate_and_render(auth_code:, redirect_uri:, template:, data:)
      token = exchange_code(auth_code, redirect_uri)
      return { error: 'authentication_failed' } unless token

      render_pdf(template, data, token)
    end

    private

    def exchange_code(code, redirect_uri)
      # Validate the redirect_uri used in token exchange matches what was authorized
      unless @oauth.validate_redirect(redirect_uri)
        return nil
      end

      uri = URI.parse(ENV['PDF_OAUTH_TOKEN_ENDPOINT'] || 'https://auth.internal/token')
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = true
      http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER

      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.path)
      request.set_form_data({
        'grant_type' => 'authorization_code',
        'code' => code,
        'redirect_uri' => redirect_uri,
        'client_id' => @oauth.client_id,
        'client_secret' => @oauth.client_secret
      })

      response = http.request(request)
      return nil unless response.code == '200'

      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    rescue StandardError
      nil
    end

    def render_pdf(template, data, token)
      # PDF rendering logic with authenticated token
      { status: 'rendered', template: template, token_prefix: token[0..7] }
    end
  end
end
